Independent full source/type/definition/body review of original lem:flat-sides, including its flatpr:fusion alias, against reference/SM/sm-1-polygons.tex lines 751–893 and inherited definitions at def:polygon, def:generic, def:crossings, def:gauss, def:interlace and def:germ. The reviewer did not author Lean or edit the declaration map. This review supersedes the mathematical incompleteness boundaries of the historical checkpoint033–035 partial reviews for this one source row; those historical reports remain unchanged. It does not certify any main wall-crossing law, soft theorem or the separately recorded original lem:shift scope omission.

DOMAIN AND SOURCE HYPOTHESES. SM.flat_sides is quantified over an actual WallGerm of parent size n+1 with n>=3; flat_parent_size proves this covers every source parent size N>=4, including four-to-three deletion. The NeZero n instance is redundant under that bound. WallGerm is an actual continuous map on its positive-radius real open interval, Generic at every punctured parameter. Generic is the accepted all-distinct-vertex-triple G1 together with full absence of three distinct edge-interior concurrence, matching the source's punctured assumptions. At the centre, hz is the exact finite singleton of unordered zero point-triple supports and hc is the empty set of unordered pairwise remote interior-concurrence triples. StrictBetween is an actual strict affine interior point with distinct endpoints. No central G1, Generic, WeakGeneric, derivative, supplied crossing bijection or asserted deletion property is assumed. The raw continuous-curve theorem flat_sides_curve constructs the germ through pointZeroCurveGerm; nongenericity of the centre follows from the nonempty zero support, rather than strengthening the raw source premise. The hypothesis hsc is the actual turn sign, cast to the reals, in WallGerm.SignChanges. Its definition and proved signChanges_iff_real express the source's product at t and -t being negative for every sufficiently small positive t. The accepted turn_det identity gives precisely the printed oriented determinant sign.

CLAUSE (i). The central foundations derive vertex injectivity from the unique zero triple and N>=4, hence every edge is nonzero. The cyclic turn-support argument covers the four-vertex case and proves the unique zero turn is exactly j. Strict betweenness makes the two incident edge vectors positive multiples; all other turn determinants are nonzero. Regular is the actual nonzero/non-antiparallel pair condition, permitting the positive-flat zero turn, so central regularity supplies the printed absence of antiparallel consecutive directions. FlatSidesData explicitly contains these conclusions. Every ordered triple of distinct labels with unordered support different from the critical support has exactly its central nonzero chi sign throughout the common interval. This covers all permutations and all noncritical point triples, not only selected edge tests.

CLAUSE (ii), SPATIAL GEOMETRY AND SUPPORTS. CrossingGeometry is a proved auxiliary property of actual segments, not a source assumption: nonzero edges, every remote closed meeting in both actual interiors with nonzero determinant, and full G2. Its flat-centre proof uses strict betweenness to rule out the two possible exceptional nonincident contacts and handles the positive-flat adjacent pair directly. Thus it does not silently apply generic G1 at the centre or ignore the exceptional neighbouring remote pairs. The complete IsCrossing relation uses actual finite unordered remote pairs with geometric meetings; on CrossingGeometry this is precisely the transverse interior relation printed for central records. Spatial conclusions are obtained at zero from the flat hypotheses and at every nonzero parameter from the full Generic hypothesis. FlatSidesData explicitly asserts injectivity of actual crossingPoint and inequality of every crossingPoint with every vertex. The vertex-exclusion helper checks both incident endpoints by injectivity of a nonzero edge's affine parametrization, and every nonincident vertex by exclusion from the actual closed segment. Therefore 'no crossing is a vertex' is not weakened to merely being interior on its two named edges.

GeometricRecordsAgree contains full equivalence of IsCrossing on all finite supports, so no new crossing elsewhere is omitted and every later crossing corresponds to a central one. The finite disjoint/transverse segment-stability and actual Cramer-parameter arguments establish support, order and determinant-sign persistence. The final conclusion also explicitly includes CrossingParameterOrderAgrees: for every edge and both crossing partners the strict parameter comparison is the central comparison. The supporting bridge identifies edgeParameter with the actual crossing/visit parameter. Equal partners are included, and distinct crossings sharing an edge have different central parameters by the actual point-injectivity argument. Thus the printed constant order on every edge is directly present in the theorem, not inferred only from a chosen word.

CLAUSE (ii), ACTUAL RECORDS. Geometric visits are the genuine sigma type of a crossing and one of its two incident edge labels, with actual intersection parameter and half-open traversal position. Their complete Gauss list is the sorted finite universe of visits; their Gauss word is its rotation class after projecting to crossing labels. These geometric definitions are proved equal to the accepted Generic definitions whenever Generic holds and remain genuine segment constructions at the nongeneric centre. The local records assertion proves equality of independently sorted complete lists under the canonical support-preserving visit equivalence, exact Cycle-word transport, and equivalence of the actual alternating-four-visit interlacement relation. The visit equivalence retains the crossing projection and edge label, so the actual two-visit pairing is preserved, not reassigned. Directed crossingSign is the sign of the actual direction determinant, and its equality on every crossing gives the same positive over/under data; the opposite source bracket convention is not substituted. No arbitrary input word, selected subset of visits or reversed traversal appears, and empty crossing/visit sets are covered.

CLAUSE (iii), ACTUAL DELETION AND GENERICITY. deleteVertex restricts the actual tuple along the proved injective/exhaustive retained-label map, omitting exactly j. Its cut starts at the old successor and ends at the old predecessor, so the child closing edge is exactly P(j+1)-P(j-1), with the correct orientation through modular wraparound. The actual insertion/deletion identity recovers the parent after the corresponding cyclic shift. Child G1 follows because its retained triples avoid j and cannot be the critical zero support. Child G2 is proved by lifting actual fused-edge interior points to one of the two old interiors; at the middle point an unchanged edge would contradict the proved vertex exclusion, and away from it a triple would lift to three distinct parent interiors, contradicting full central G2. This proof does not assume the desired fusion bijection or deletion Generic circularly.

FlatFusionData explicitly states Generic of this actual child and supplies one coefficient strictly between zero and one, the two exact positive vector-scale identities against its closing edge, and the actual affine visit-parameter formula. The fusionIndex map sends either incident edge to that closing edge and every other edge to its retained label. Its image support is asserted for every actual crossing. Image remoteness is proved geometrically for actual crossings, not falsely assumed for every remote parent pair. The constructed crossing equivalence is proved bijective: the actual point is preserved; injectivity follows from parent point injectivity/G2; surjectivity lifts a genuine child crossing and excludes the middle point with an unchanged edge. No uniqueness is assumed merely from the subdivision disjunction. The visit equivalence uses the corresponding bijection in each actual two-edge fibre and explicitly preserves edge images and the crossing pairing.

CLAUSE (iii), CYCLIC ORDER AND WORDS. The actual first-piece parameter is scaled by the coefficient; the second is offset by that coefficient and scaled by its positive complement. Same-edge orders and the first-piece-before-second-piece comparison are proved. FusionKey strengthens this to arbitrary triples of actual visits: the old cut is shifted by j+1, exact natural-value identities handle retained, first and second incident indices including wraparound, and a three-piece strictly increasing scalar compression gives exactly the child visit keys. The final order iff composes this with the proved cyclic shift law for the whole half-open traversal circle; it never assumes that an unchanged linear cut survives deletion. SortedCompressedCut separately proves rotation equivalence of the independently sorted full parent/child visit lists by splitting before/after the cut, proving the rotated compressed list sorted and using its actual permutation with the child list. This includes empty lists and empty cut portions. Projecting that proved rotation yields the exact actual Gauss-word transport, not an arbitrary relabelling certificate. The interlacement proof transports both distinct visits of each crossing and both alternating arc conditions in both directions. FlatFusionData explicitly binds these conclusions and the actual crossing/visit equivalences. Its determinant-sign and strict positive-determinant equivalences follow from products of strictly positive edge scales, preserving the printed positive over/under convention.

COMMON INTERVAL AND DELETED CHAMBERS. The final proof uses one positive minimum of the local-record/sign radius, deletion radius, actual turn-sign-change radius and explicit parameter-order radius. It proves this radius is bounded by the original radius. Every local geometric, sign, order, record and deletion assertion is quantified over every original interval-subtype parameter with absolute value below that same radius, including zero and both sides. The actual sign-change product remains asserted for all small positive side distances on that radius. Nearby coordinate deletions are genuinely continuous; openness of the full Generic locus and a continuous lift of the connected real interval into the Generic subtype give membership in the central deletion's labelled connected component and in its actual cyclic-quotient connected component. Chambers are not replaced by combinatorial sign classes. This covers the source's deletion-chamber clause as well as its central deletion and fusion conclusions.

AUDIT AND CURRENT-BYTE BINDING. Candidate checkpoint036 and stage-development.json are byte-identical with SHA256 18ee48f2a22e2a3578c6b3f62f31d7d8fee372b0eba7f80773282676186dc6ad, passed=true, stage=null and stage_accepted=false. I independently verified the exact 142-module SM inventory, all 148 project-file hashes and all 38 frozen bundle hashes. The audit reports 1452 local declarations and 24 mapped claims. The 110-entry semantic dependency inventory for SM.flat_sides includes its transparent FlatSidesData/FlatFusionData and the actual geometry, germ, crossing, visit and quotient definitions. Recomputing the canonical JSON dependency digest gives the recorded 390e52915488af936ec194118130b4e6e0e9123922c47211147040be011980f2. The current declaration-audit.json SHA256 is 708d1980473f7bbb9f3a901004b95946a4e355bd1b7836685a043dcbf7e104aa. The inspected actual type/definition/axiom trace has SHA256 a41453ec0030a7e7740965ea1fd6e7e2334b523ad36aceacfe2264a24b5a4be4, and the full build log has SHA256 45c223b1c57781c2190928281d331d7c2cbc75a6de278bcab1ff5aae38a98ed0. Both full theorems use only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound; there are no literature or project axioms in their audit. The proof bodies were reviewed from their current source files, not inferred from an audit that omits theorem bodies. The full 91-file local import closure below binds that cumulative source/body review: the prior 83 inspected files are unchanged, SortedCut matches the earlier accepted review, and all seven new modules were independently inspected. Builds and hashes bind this substantive review; they are not substituted for it. Only this one complete original source claim is eligible for acceptance; helpers add no original proof count, and this is not stage or final-target completion.
